description: Simulator comparison of MLAE, IQAE-style adaptive likelihood, canonical grid-QAE, Monte Carlo, and quasi-Monte Carlo for g0/g1/g2.
notes: This is a statistical simulator using the ideal binomial QAE model p_k(a), not a circuit-level Aer simulation.
The IQAE entry is an adaptive likelihood proxy: at each step it chooses the k in [0,max_k] that minimizes the expected posterior interval width.
Canonical QAE is represented by the ideal phase-estimation grid estimator with M=2^m evaluation states.
